about_the_game:
Long-awaited piano arrangements of music from the beloved NieR series!

Produced by series composer Keiichi Okabe, this collection features arrangements from MONACA's own Keigo Hoashi, Ryuichi Takada, and Yuri Misumi, as well as famed composers Kumi Tanioka (FINAL FANTASY: CRYSTAL CHRONICLES) and Masato Koda (El Shaddai ASCENSION OF THE METATRON). These artists each interpret the music of NieR in their own way and bring it to life using the beautiful, ethereal sounds of the piano in this long-awaited album of arrangements.

This information is from the time of the CD release in March 2012.
